title: Deep Neural Network Approaches for Closed-Loop Deep Brain Stimulation
brief_summary: In this research study the researchers want to learn more about brain activity related to speech perception and production in patients with Parkinson's Disease who are undergoing deep brain stimulation (DBS).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Subjects scheduled for DBS implantation, as determined by the clinical multidisciplinary movement disorders board with definitive diagnosis of Parkinson's disease
2. Subjects able to provide informed consent and comply with task instructions.
3. Subjects 18-85 years old

Exclusion Criteria:

1\. Non-English-speaking subjects
